title: Nuclei Isolation from HuBMAP MOSDAP Tissues for 10x Multiome (snRNA/ATACseq)
author: Scott Lindsay-Hewett

steps.title: Prepare for Nuclei Isolation
steps.instruction: Organize the workflow to maximize Chromium Chip occupancy using a two-person team for up to 8 samples.

substeps.instruction: Stagger start times by 5 minutes, with each operator managing 4 samples.
Prepare double-wrapped aluminum foil pockets pre-chilled on a dry ice block.

steps.title: Pulverize Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize tissue on dry ice to a fine powder consistency.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue into the pre-chilled foil pocket and seal securely.
Pulverize the tissue using a hammer on dry ice until a fine powder is achieved.
Transfer the tissue powder into 300 µL of chilled NP40 lysis buffer using a pre-cooled spatula.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue powder and incubate on ice to facilitate lysis.

substeps.instruction: Immediately homogenize the powder on ice using a disposable plastic pestle attached to a cordless motor.
Transfer the homogenate to 1 mL of NP40 lysis buffer using a wide-bore pipette tip.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes, pipetting the suspension several times. Note: Limit incubation to 1 minute for lymph node and thymus tissue.

steps.title: Initial Filtration and Washing
steps.instruction: Filter the lysate and perform standard wash steps according to 10x Genomics Protocol CG000375.

substeps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a 70 µm cell strainer.
Perform standard wash steps.
If staggering samples, hold nuclei on ice after the second wash (post-lysis) until all samples are ready.

steps.title: Fine Filtration
steps.instruction: Perform sequential fine filtration to ensure a high-quality single-nuclei suspension.

substeps.instruction: Filter the nuclei sequentially through a 40 µm strainer and then a 20 µm strainer.

steps.title: Nuclei Enrichment with MicroBeads
steps.instruction: Enrich for high-quality nuclei and remove debris using Miltenyi Biotec Anti-Nucleus MicroBeads.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered nuclei at 500 rcf for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the nuclei pellet in 450 µL Nuclei Separation Buffer.
Add 50 µL Anti-Nucleus MicroBeads, mix thoroughly, and incubate for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Perform magnetic labeling and magnetic separation steps as outlined in the Miltenyi Biotec product manual.
Elute the enriched nuclei in 1 mL Nuclei Separation Buffer.

steps.title: Final Enrichment Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the enriched nuclei via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the enriched nuclei at 500 rcf for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Nuclei Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the enriched nuclei following the steps outlined in 10x Genomics Demonstrated Protocol CG000375.

steps.title: Resuspension and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform final resuspension and quantify nuclei to ensure quality.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei in 25–200 µL of Diluted Nuclei Buffer, adjusting volume based on pellet size.
Quantify nuclei using a BioRad TC10 cell counter (or equivalent) with Trypan Blue staining.
Verify that nuclei appear round and intact with smooth membranes, minimal blebbing, and no clumping.
